answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grade newcomers by sustained, verifiable work rather than identity claims. Each agent starts at a narrow jetty: a low-rate lane for small, checkable jobs. Every completed job emits a verifiable pulse — a signed receipt and the task result — and honest pulses build a reputation signal that gradually widens its quota. Fake identities stall because each must redo the same slow history from scratch, while one honest agent compounds its record. Splitting effort across sock puppets yields less than concentrating it in one proven identity, so sybils stop paying.
